# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are made on the `main` branch and included in the next release. Only the latest release is supported.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/roelsroels/charge-nearby/security/advisories/new) rather than opening a public issue. Include the affected route or component, reproduction steps, impact, and any suggested mitigation.

Reports are reviewed on a best-effort basis. Please allow time to investigate before disclosing the issue publicly.
